jobs.title: Senior Database Administrator / Data Engineer - PostgreSQL / MySQL
jobs.description: Posted Date 9/21/2026 Description #### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. Verizon Connect has an immediate need for an experienced Database Administrator based in the Atlanta Georgia region to join our Global Database Services team. The ideal associate will be a highly competent, results driven as well as a highly self\-motivated individual. This DBA role requires a service oriented mentality, high sense of ownership of the problems and requests assigned, focus on managing and resolving issues in a prompt \& efficient manor, establishing and maintaining communication with technology customers to keep them updated with status of their requests, initiating and performing changes on production systems and proactively escalating any issues that cannot be resolved within the established timeframes. **Responsibilities:** * Owning, tracking and resolving database related incidents and requests. * Fulfilling requests and resolving incidents within SLAs. * Reviewing service\-related reports (e.g. database backups, maintenance, monitoring) on a daily basis to ensure operational issues are identified and resolved promptly. * Responding to database related alerts and escalations and working with database engineering to come up with strategic solutions to recurring problems. * Enhancing automation for database platform provision process * Enhancing database monitoring \& alerting platforms to ensure proactive alerting is always achieved. **What we’re looking for...** **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Four or more yars of relevant Database administration experience in a large data environment * Deep understanding of PostgreSQL \& MySQL database architecture and internal components with particular focus on :\- + Custom automated vacuuming + Re\-indexing + Statistics + Partition maintenance + H/A implementations + Backups, restores \& Point\-in\-time recovery + Security + Monitoring \& alerting * Advanced knowledge of Database Administration on the PostgreSQL (versions 17 \& 18\) platforms. * Advanced knowledge of Database Administration on the MySQL (8\.4\) platforms. * Advanced knowledge of Troubleshooting and resolving database problems in a high transaction OLTP environment. * Advanced knowledge of Database Performance Tuning \& Optimization and Query cost management * Advance knowledge of writing, debugging and tuning of SQL / PLSQL code * Deep knowledge of Partitioning on both MySQL \& PostgreSQL * Deep knowledge of vacuum processes and housekeeping of large databases (\>2TB) * Significant operational and support experience with large data platforms * Experience with scripting/automation (Powershell / Python / sparc preferred). **Even better if you have:** * Experience with PostgreSQL \& MySQL in an AWS environment, especially RDS Aurora implementations. * Experience with ownership \& management of ElasticSearch in AWS * Experience with ownership \& management of Redshift in AWS * Experience in working as part of a geographically dispersed team * Experience in any other database management systems (such as SQL Server) * Ability to learn new technologies and scripting languages * Ability to work in a fast paced, high volume, agile environment. * Ability to approach problems with a sense of ownership, enthusiasm and innovation If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. #### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. #### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 #### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. #### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. Type Full\-time

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, AI Engineer (IFX)
jobs.description: Posted Date 9/21/2026 Description Sr. Manager, AI Engineer (IFX) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. Team Description: The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI * Translate enterprise AI goals into actionable team roadmaps with measurable outcomes and regular readouts * Operationalize Responsible AI: establish review gates, documentation/evaluation requirements, and rollout/rollback standards for all production AI systems * Create strong collaboration interfaces with Research, Data, and Platform teams to accelerate model lifecycle **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands\-on when necessary and lead by example * You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven * You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss * You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies * At least 1 year of people leadership experience **Preferred Qualifications:** * 3 years of experience managing and leading an engineering team * 6 years of experie s to peers * Experience leading technical strategy for a multi\-disciplinary AI team, balancing research exploration with production delivery * Familiarity with MLOps, AI observability (evaluation pipelines, drift monitoring, model/version governance) to ensure reliability and compliance * Track record mentoring engineers/scientists to productize prototypes and meet production SLOs * Experience right\-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs) ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please. jobs.title: Business Development Manager – Automation & Intelligence Division
jobs.description: **Join Inframark:** Pioneering Automation and Intelligence Step into the future with Inframark's award\-winning Automation and Intelligence team. We deliver cutting\-edge solutions in instrumentation and controls, industrial cybersecurity, data analysis, and remote network operations center services for water and wastewater plants. Elevate your career and join us at Inframark. Apply today! Why Work for Inframark? Our dedication to sustainability and community impact drives us to ensure clean, safe water for future generations. Whether you're at the start of your career or looking for advancement, Inframark offers purpose\-driven work and opportunities for growth. We offer an attractive salary package, including a generous benefits package with health, dental, and life insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off, sick leave, holidays, and wellness plan. **Job Title:** Business Development Manager – Automation \& Intelligence Division **Location:** Atlanta **Company Overview:** Inframark is a recognized leader in providing advanced infrastructure management solutions across the United States, with a focus on water and wastewater systems. Our Automation \& Intelligence Division specializes in cutting\-edge systems integration, industrial automation, cybersecurity, and data analytics driven by artificial intelligence. As part of our commitment to technological innovation, we work with municipalities, engineering firms, and utility contractors to deliver comprehensive and scalable automation solutions that enhance operational efficiency, sustainability, and resilience. We are seeking an experienced and technically adept Business Development Manager to help expand our market presence by engaging with key stakeholders such as consulting engineers, large municipalities, and industry decision\-makers. **Job Summary:** The Business Development Manager will drive strategic growth by identifying and securing complex, high\-value opportunities within large municipalities and the consulting engineering sector. This role requires deep technical expertise in industrial automation and water/wastewater systems, along with a consultative sales approach to engage and influence key stakeholders. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Sales, you will collaborate with internal teams to develop tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of municipal and engineering clients. This position is essential in shaping the company's strategic direction, building long\-term relationships, and ensuring the successful execution of large\-scale automation projects. **Key Responsibilities:** * Strategic Business Development: Lead the creation and execution of business development strategies that target large municipalities and consulting engineers involved in water and wastewater infrastructure projects. Identify emerging opportunities, including those in regulatory compliance, sustainability initiatives, and digital transformation efforts in water management. * Technical Consulting \& Solution Design: Provide strategic technical consultation to municipalities and consulting engineers by identifying operational challenges and proposing tailored automation and intelligence solutions that address their specific needs. Leverage deep knowledge of process instrumentation, SCADA systems, and AI\-powered data analytics to design innovative, scalable systems that optimize water and wastewater operations. * Stakeholder Engagement \& Relationship Management: Cultivate relationships with key decision\-makers at engineering firms, municipal utilities, and government entities. Foster a deep understanding of customer pain points, goals, and project timelines, positioning Inframark as a trusted partner and thought leader in the automation space. Maintain long\-term, value\-driven relationships to secure ongoing business and referrals. * Project Lifecycle Management: Collaborate with consulting engineers, project managers, and technical teams to align sales strategies with project requirements, from initial needs assessments through design, implementation, and ongoing support. Help guide clients through the entire project lifecycle, ensuring the successful deployment of automation solutions and the integration of AI\-driven intelligence for enhanced operational decision\-making. * Technical Market Analysis \& Competitive Intelligence: Monitor market trends, technological advancements, and industry standards related to industrial automation, water management, and AI analytics. Analyze competitor activities and identify gaps in the market that can be leveraged for business growth. Provide insights to the executive team regarding market opportunities and competitive positioning. * Proposal Development \& Negotiation: Generate content of detailed, technical proposals in collaboration with internal teams. Work closely with engineering, project management, and technical teams to define solution architecture, scope, and costs. Negotiate contractual terms and condi -party vendors to ensure seamless integration of solutions. * Revenue Growth \& KPI Tracking: Work with the Regional Sales Manager to drive the achievement of revenue goals by consistently identifying and closing large\-scale, multi\-phase projects. Track and report on KPIs, including sales pipeline progress, revenue generation, opportunity close rates, and customer satisfaction metrics. * Internal Collaboration: Work cross\-functionally with product development, marketing, engineering, and operations teams to ensure that customer solutions align with company capabilities and strategic goals. Provide feedback to internal teams regarding customer needs, product requirements, and market dynamics. * Thought Leadership \& Industry Advocacy: Represent Inframark at industry conferences, webinars, and technical forums. Position yourself and the company as a thought leader in automation and artificial intelligence within the water and wastewater sectors. Educate customers on emerging technologies and industry best practices to drive engagement and loyalty. **Qualifications/Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field (Master’s degree or MBA is a plus). * A minimum of 7 years of experience in business development, sales, or consulting within the industrial automation, water/wastewater, or infrastructure sectors. Experience working with large municipalities and consulting engineering firms is strongly preferred. * In\-depth technical knowledge of automation systems, process instrumentation, SCADA architecture, PLCs, control systems, and data analytics in the context of water/wastewater management. * Proven ability to design and propose customized, technically complex solutions to meet the operational needs of large municipalities and engineering consultants. * Strong network within the water/wastewater sector, including relationships with municipal leaders, utility managers, engineering firms, and key industry vendors. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels, from engineers to C\-suite executives. * Demonstrated success in managing long sales cycles, large project portfolios, and complex stakeholder negotiations. * Expertise in managing CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales enablement software. **Preferred Technical Knowledge:** * Extensive understanding of water and wastewater treatment processes, including instrumentation, control systems, and cybersecurity. * Familiarity with regulatory standards in water management and environmental compliance, as well as trends toward digitalization and smart infrastructure. * Proficiency in AI, machine learning, and data analytics applications for predictive maintenance, performance optimization, and operational efficiency in the water sector. **Physical Demands:** * Requires travel to customer sites, industry events, and project meetings as needed. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. **Join Our Team:** If you are a strategic, technically\-driven business development professional with a passion for water/wastewater infrastructure, automation, and AI, we invite you to apply. Join Inframark’s Automation \& Intelligence Division and help us drive the digital transformation of municipal water and wastewater systems. To support a safe and secure workplace, all offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of background screening, drug testing, and driving record review where applicable. Inframark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. Learn more about us at Automation and Intelligence \- Inframark

jobs.title: Co-op, DevOps Engineer: January - June 2027 (Hybrid)
jobs.description: Job Summary Co\-op, DevOps Engineer: January \- June 2027 (Hybrid)\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **Position Overview** ===================== **Position Dates: January 11, 2027 – June 30, 2027** Insulet is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented DevOps Engineer to join our team within our Software Research and Development organization. As an Associate DevOps Engineer you will support the design, maintenance, and operation of continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines used to build, package, test, and deploy products. Working under the guidance of senior team members, you will help automate repetitive processes, support software release activities, and contribute to continuous improvement across development teams. **Responsibilities** * Monitor CI/CD pipeline runs, investigate basic failures, and escalate recurring or complex issues to senior DevOps team members. * Maintain build and deployment documentation, including runbooks, setup steps, and troubleshooting notes for supported tools and environments. jobs.description: **Are you ready to shape the future of IT? Join Integris, where integrity meets innovation, and people come first.** At Integris, we don’t just offer jobs, we offer purpose. As a nationally recognized **Best Places to Work** and a leader in **future\-ready managed services**, we’re redefining how businesses experience IT. If you’re passionate about innovation, driven by impact, and ready to grow with a company that puts **People First**, you’ll find your place here. **Job Summary:** The Systems Technician is responsible for providing frontline technical support for single end\-user level issues, including personal computer, printer, Microsoft 365, Windows application, mobile device, and basic connectivity matters. This role serves as the initial point of contact for client technical assistance and is responsible for managing inquiries received through phone, email, and the client portal. The Systems Technician provides exceptional customer service while troubleshooting and resolving support requests efficiently and effectively. This position may execute responsibilities from the service desk, the field, a client site, an Integris office, or a remote home office depending on business and client needs. This role is expected to build technical capability over time, follow documented processes, maintain accurate service ticket documentation, and escalate complex technical issues to Systems Administrators or Systems Engineers when appropriate. The Systems Technician contributes to a positive client experience and plays an important role in maintaining daily service delivery operations. **Job Responsibilities:** *Ticket Management* * Work assigned tickets in order of SLA. * Serve as the first point of contact for client support requests received through phone, email, and client portal. * Answer inbound support calls, create service tickets, and ensure requests are properly documented, categorized, and prioritized. * Troubleshoot and resolve frontline technical issues efficiently and effectively to minimize disruption to customer operations. * Escalate advanced or unresolved technical issues to Systems Administrators or Systems Engineers following established escalation procedures. * Document all technical work comprehensively to facilitate accurate client billing and ongoing support. *Collaboration, Communication, and Customer Service* * Demonstrate excellent customer service skills with a focus on professionalism, responsiveness, and problem\-solving. * Communicate clearly with clients regarding ticket status, troubleshooting steps, next steps, and resolution details. * Collaborate with Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, and other technical team members to resolve client issues. * Participate in team meetings, training sessions, documentation efforts, and knowledge\-sharing activities. * Follow up with clients and internal team members as needed to support timely issue resolution and a positive client experience. *Technical Support* *\& Documentation* * Provide frontline technical support for end\-user devices, Microsoft 365 applications, and common infrastructure issues, escalating complex issues as appropriate. * Support the configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of workstations, peripheral devices, and basic server, networking, and cloud technologies under established procedures. * Assist with Microsoft 365 user administration, including account provisioning, password resets, licensing, and basic support for Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint. * Troubleshoot common connectivity issues involving workstations, printers, wireless networks, VPN access, and basic network services, escalating advanced networking issues when necessary. * Support backup verification, endpoint management, documentation, ticketing, remote management, and monitoring tools as part of daily operational activities. * Collaborate with Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, and other team members to resolve client issues while continuing to develop technical knowledge and skills. * Follow established IT service management processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to deliver consistent, high\-quality support. * Maintain accurate documentation of work performed and contribute to knowledge base articles and SOP updates as appropriate. *Professional Development \& Technical Growth* * Demonstrate curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Microsoft technologies, networking fundamentals, service delivery, and client support. * Participate in training, coaching, and certification pathways that support continued growth into advanced technical responsibilities. * Leverage approved AI solutions responsibly to accelerate learning, improve troubleshooting efficiency, enhance documentation quality, and support better customer outcomes. * Develop foundational technical knowledge that prepares the employee for potential progression into Systems Administrator responsibilities. **Job Qualifications** *Education/Certification Requirements:* * Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience). * Valid driver’s license. * Entry\-level certifications are preferred. Examples including but not limited to:? + CompTIA A\+ + Google IT Support Professional Certificate + Microsoft Fundamentals certifications + CompTIA Network\+ *Experience Requirements:* * 1\-3 years of experience in technical support, help desk, desktop support, call center technical support, field support, or related IT support roles. * Experience supporting Microsoft operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, basic networking issues, and end\-user technology. * Experience delivering customer\-facing support with a strong focus on professionalism, communication, and service quality. * Experience working within a Managed Services Provider (MSP), consulting, or multi\-client IT support environment is preferred. *Technical Knowledge \& Experience (including, but not limited to):* * Administration and troubleshooting of Windows workstation environments. * Basic Microsoft 365 administration and end\-user support. * Basic Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID user administration. * Basic understanding of Azure cloud concepts and Microsoft cloud services. * Basic networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, wireless connectivity, and general connectivity troubleshooting. * Experience using ticketing systems and remote support tools, including ConnectWise or similar platforms. * Familiarity with endpoint management and remote monitoring tools, including Intune, ConnectWise Automate, or similar technologies. * Familiarity with firewall, wireless, and network support tools, including WatchGuard, Meraki, or similar technologies. * Working knowledge of hardware, printers, mobile devices, peripherals, and workstation deployment.? * Working knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, user security awareness, data privacy, and appropriate handling of client information. * Working knowledge of AI\-assisted productivity and support tools, including Microsoft Copilot, Chat GPT Enterprise, and other approved generative AI solutions. * Ability to leverage AI tools responsibly to improve troubleshooting efficiency, documentation quality, and customer support outcomes. At **Integris**, we value our team members and **offer comprehensive benefits**, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401K Retirement Plan * Minimum 4 Weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) * Birthday PTO * Paid Holidays * Paid Time Off for Volunteering * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Life Insurance * Supplemental Insurance * Employee Assistance Program Join us in transforming IT services for small and midsize businesses across regulated industries. Be part of a team that’s scaling nationally, investing in vertical expertise, and **building for better**. *Integris is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, familial status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected class under applicable federal, state, and local laws.* *\#LI\-Hyrbid*

jobs.description: Overview: **Job Purpose** Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents an opportunity for a full\-time Lead Developer to join our AI Center of Excellence (AICOE) team, responsible for architecting and managing the AICOE platform’s CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure. Exceptional professionalism, proactive collaboration, and outstanding communication skills are essential. Strong written and verbal communication skills are imperative, given the candidate’s responsibility to articulate pipeline efficiency metrics, deployment reliability improvements, resource allocation strategies, and platform ROI clearly and persuasively to both technical teams and leadership, including presenting build and release metrics, infrastructure cost optimization, and platform scalability plans to AICOE leadership. **Responsibilities** * Architecting, implementing, and managing the AICOE platform’s CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure. * Driving innovation, operational excellence, and scalability within the AICOE team’s build, release, and deployment environments. * Leading technical strategy for the AICOE platform’s CI/CD and infrastructure, including support for AI and inference workloads where required. * Effectively collaborate with developers, engineers, and business stakeholders to align platform capabilities with strategic objectives. **Knowledge and Experience** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 5\+ years of experience and demonstrated leadership in designing and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins. * Strong programming and scripting skills with hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines end to end. * Proficiency with GitHub Actions and Jenkins for build, test, and deployment automation. * Deep, hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, and AWS EKS, including Helm charts and container orchestration for production environments. * Proficiency with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible) and configuration management. * Strong experience with container technologies including Docker, and orchestration for production workloads. * Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) for platform and pipeline health. * Extensive experience in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including compute, networking, and storage services. * Experience leading platform engineering development in cross\-functional teams of developers and engineers. * Expertise in CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, and deployment, including automated rollback and release workflows. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills in CI/CD and platform infrastructure challenges and strategic thinking for platform scalability. * Excellence in explaining complex infrastructure solutions to technical teams and business stakeholders. * Experience in enterprise environments, working with governance, compliance, and secure software delivery practices. * Exposure to supporting AI/ML or inference platform infrastructure is a plus, but not a core requirement of this role. * Comprehensive knowledge of build automation, release management, versioning, and automated testing frameworks. * Advanced programming and scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, Bash), with proficiency in performance optimization. * Proven leadership abilities in guiding cross\-functional platform engineering teams and mentoring developers. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and executive audiences. \#LI\-MA1 \-: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

position be based in Lisle, Illinois Monday through Thursday with hybrid in\-office and remote work flexibility on Friday **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data products supporting RSM and broader commercial intelligence capabilities. * Integrate, normalize, and model customer, prospect, dealer, vehicle, sales, service, parts, CRM, digital interaction, and external data. * Develop robust approaches for identity resolution, entity matching, deduplication, normalization, lineage, and data quality across complex commercial datasets. * Build and operationalize analytical and machine\-learning models for lead scoring, opportunity identification, customer segmentation, propensity, prioritization, and next\-best\-action recommendations. * Translate complex commercial data into actionable intelligence embedded directly into dealer and sales workflows—not simply reports and dashboards. * Partner with Product, Sales, Commercial, UX, Data, and Engineering teams to turn high\-value business problems into scalable data and analytical solutions. * Design reusable commercial data models, semantic structures, and ontology concepts for customers, prospects, vehicles, dealers, opportunities, and sales activity. * Define and monitor data quality, model performance, and business\-impact metrics and resolve issues affecting the trustworthiness of commercial intelligence. * Prototype and evaluate AI/ML approaches, including generative AI and LLM\-based capabilities, that improve commercial decision\-making and sales effectiveness. * Establish engineering and data\-science practices covering testing, observability, documentation, governance, versioning, CI/CD, and production deployment. * Own what you build, including operational readiness, production support, incident response, quality standards, and technical lifecycle management. * Serve as a senior technical leader within the RSM product team, influencing architecture and technical direction while mentoring other practitioners. * Communicate complex analytical findings and technical decisions clearly to technical teams, product leaders, commercial stakeholders, and senior leadership. **What We’re Looking For*** Strong hands\-on experience building production\-grade data pipelines, data models, analytical products, and commercial intelligence solutions at enterprise scale. * Advanced SQL and Python skills with sound software\-engineering practices. * Experience with modern cloud data platforms and distributed processing; Palantir Foundry/AIP and/or Databricks strongly preferred. * Experience developing, deploying, and monitoring machine\-learning or statistical models against large, complex datasets. * Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, observability, governance, testing, and production operations. * Experience solving entity resolution, identity matching, customer\-360, master\-data, or similar commercial data problems. * Experience with customer, sales, CRM, marketing, vehicle, transactional, service, parts, or other commercial datasets. * hnical work, defining solution approaches, and influencing architecture or data strategy across cross\-functional teams. * Qualified candidates, excluding current employees, must be legally authorized on an unrestricted basis to be employed in the United States. We do not anticipate providing employment related work sponsorship for this position (e.g., H\-1B status). * Deep experience with Palantir Foundry, including data pipelines, ontology design, AIP, OSDK, and operational applications. * Experience with Databricks and modern lakehouse/data\-engineering patterns. Experience * ing machine learning to sales, lead generation, customer intelligence, propensity, recommendation, or next\-best\-action use cases. * Experience with commercial vehicle, automotive, industrial B2B, dealer/distributor, or complex channel\-sales environments. * Experience with API\-first and event\-driven architectures and integrating analytical data products into production applications. * Experience with domain\-driven design, semantic modeling, master data, or commercial data domains. * Advanced degree in computer science, data science, statistics, engineering, analytics, or a related quantitative discipline. **Benefits and Compensation** This position offers competitive market\-based compensation, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee wellbeing. You can learn more about the benefits offered for this position by visiting https://careers.international.com/\#benefits. The expected salary offered for this position will fall within the stated range, with the final offer based on the candidates' applicable skills, knowledge, and experience. **Company Overview** **About TRATON** With its brands Scania, MAN, International, and Volkswagen Truck \& Bus, TRATON SE is the parent and holding company of the TRATON GROUP and one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. The Group’s product portfolio comprises trucks, buses, and light\-duty commercial vehicles. “Transforming Transportation Together. For a sustainable world.”: this intention underlines the Company’s ambition to have a lasting and sustainable impact on the commercial vehicle business and on the Group’s commercial growth. **About International** From a one\-man company built on the world\-changing invention of the McCormick reaper in 1831, to the 15,000\-person\-strong company we are today, few companies can lay claim to a history like International. Based in Lisle, Illinois, International Motors, LLC\* creates solutions that deliver greater uptime and productivity to our customers throughout the full operation of our commercial vehicles. We build International® trucks and engines and IC Bus® school and commercial buses that are as tough and as smart as the people who drive them. We also develop Fleetrite® aftermarket parts. In everything we do, our vision is to accelerate the impact of sustainable mobility to create the cleaner, safer world we all deserve. As of 2021, we joined Scania, MAN and Volkswagen Truck \& Bus in TRATON GROUP, a global champion of the truck and transport services industry. To learn more, visit International.com.* International Motors, LLC is d/b/a International Motors USA in Illinois, Missouri, New Jersey, Ohio, Texas, and Utah. **EEO Statement** We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Oracle Fusion and Oracle EPM
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit is looking for a Principal Software Engineer (Finance Systems) in technology for Intuit (Finance, Legal and Privacy Tech) organization. The successful professional will have technical depth, business and finance acumen, and a desire to create delight in every customer experience. S/he will have a passion for driving enterprise financial products direction, technology blueprint, leading and inspiring cross\-functional teams, and influencing executives as well as engineers. A penchant for accuracy and integrity of financial data, and a flair for making judgement calls between approach and speed for a solution is essential. The ideal candidate’s experience encompasses technical architecture and/or software development, business strategy and deep domain knowledge in finance systems. This executive will have an ability to leverage prior success within a complex business that has enormous amounts of transactional, repeatable data. This highly visible position will be front and center as we work to continuously modernize our finance systems and change the way we think about and apply finance domain data in solutions across our enterprise business processes. A successful candidate for this position must possess both a deep and wide background in Oracle Fusion, Oracle EPM Cloud and Oracle Cloud technologies with extensive data technologies spanning both solutions built on traditional (RDBMS) and non\-traditional (NoSQL) platforms, defining data domains as applicable to different business processes and deep knowledge of the financial processes. As a critical member of the architecture team, the candidate should be comfortable working closely with the Enterprise Architecture team including data architects, business architects and essential stakeholders to drive technical ideas and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical audiences. **Responsibilities** * Experience putting together a strategy for complex finance transformations using Oracle Fusion, Oracle EPM and Oracle cloud technologies, driving execution to that strategy * Proficient in front\-end and back\-end architecture \& design * Experience using data insights for product refinement * Ability to work well through ambiguity, confidence in making tough calls and leading through adversity with a sharp focus on the eventual right outcomes * Arbitrates technical disagreements across teams * Partner with senior engineering leaders to build strong engineering teams * Gaining an understanding of our Current State and then defining the Target State Architecture and Strategy. Drive towards adoption of the target state architecture by executing on the strategy. Must possess the leadership qualities necessary to drive change and adoption of the strategy. * Drive end to end architecture and data domain definition across all business processes with focus on Financial processes. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, PDX Design
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Intuit, our mission is powering prosperity around the world. Every day we innovate with our flagship products — TurboTax, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, and Credit Karma — touching the financial lives of more than 100 million customers worldwide. We never stop working to find new, innovative ways to make that possible. In Design at Intuit, we are intentionally building AI into how we design, prototype, and ship — and we're committed to equipping our teams to work at the forefront of it. We look for designers who are excited to bring AI into their workflow — using it to move faster, explore further, and save their energy for the decisions that only human judgment and creativity can make. We're looking for designers who are curious, eager to experiment, and excited to continually evolve how they work. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to contribute and help shape Intuit’s AI native development platform. In this role, you will design for developer\-facing experiences across Intuit's platform — including Builder Hub, our central destination for internal builders. You'll bring a strong design point of view, champion the needs of developer audiences, and help elevate the craft and direction of the broader design team. We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about design, a collaborative team player, creative problem solver, strong communicator, and a constant advocate for the customer. Platform designers bring a unique skill set — combining deep UX craft with an understanding of developer needs, technical workflows, and platform ecosystems. This is a hybrid role requiring in\-person collaboration 3 days per week. **Responsibilities** •Drive End\-to\-End Design Execution: Contribute to complex, developer\-facing initiatives across Builder Hub and Intuit's broader platform—from problem framing and conceptualization to high\-fidelity specs and production implementation. •Design experiences that make AI\-powered features intuitive, transparent, and trustworthy for a diverse range of users •Champion Developer Empathy \& Advocacy: Develop a deep understanding of technical workflows, mental models, and pain points to design elegant experiences that eliminate friction and accelerate developer velocity. * Conduct Research \& Rapid Experimentation: Partner with research to establish clear learning plans and testable hypotheses, validating a broad spectrum of ideas through iterative prototyping and direct customer feedback. * Advance Design Vision \& Strategy: Articulate a compelling design point of view grounded in customer data and industry trends, confidently communicating design rationale to align cross\-functional stakeholders. * Scale Systems \& Elevate Craft: Contribute to and evolve platform design systems by creating reusable patterns, raising quality standards, and providing constructive feedback during design reviews.Collaborate Across Disciplines: Work seamlessly with product managers, engineers, content strategists, researchers, and analysts to transform complex technical constraints into intuitive user journeys. * Pioneer AI\-Powered Design Workflows: Actively experiment with and advocate for AI\-powered design tools and workflows — staying current with how artificial intelligence is reshaping the craft of product design and helping the team adopt effective new approaches **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Product Design, Human\-Computer Interaction Design, another relevant field, or equivalent work experience. A graduate degree is a plus. * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into your design workflow to improve quality, speed, or exploration * 4\+ years of experience in interaction design, product design, service design, or related field * Strong knowledge of design principles and methods * Expert knowledge of user\-centered design methods, including research planning, journey mapping, interaction design, prototyping, and usability testing * Expertise in conveying ideas and concepts through storyboarding, wireframing, and prototyping * Effective communicator, presenter, and negotiator * Proven experience navigating technically complex initiatives and translating technical constraints into seamless user experiences * Demonstrated mentorship and investment in the growth of colleagues and team craft * Working knowledge of design tools (Figma required); fluency in AI prototyping tools (Builder, Claude or Cursor) and agile development practices * Well\-presented online portfolio demonstrating strong craft, strategic thinking, and a collaborative process * A clear point of view on how AI is changing the craft of product design, with hands\-on experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate and elevate your work; genuine curiosity for emerging tools and how they can solve real customer problems Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Buy Now Pay Later
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit is a global technology platform company that helps our customers and communities overcome their most important financial challenges. We help give over 50 million consumers, small businesses, and self\-employed customers around the world the opportunity to prosper. The Mission Small businesses fuel the global economy. In the US alone, they employ 60% of the workforce and create 80% of new jobs. Yet, the odds are stacked against them: one in two fails within five years. One of the most severe challenges a small business faces is managing cash flow: balancing inflows and outflows, late customer payments, funding growth, and making payroll — all while hoping there is enough left over for profit or a rainy day. At QuickBooks, we aren't just building software; we are increasing the survival rate of entrepreneurship globally. QuickBooks Capital provides small businesses with access to credit products that improve their prospects and help them thrive. Our data shows that customers who take capital grow revenue more quickly than their peers, and our lending products ensure that customers have flexible, on\-demand access to capital whenever they need it. The Opportunity This role owns the strategy and execution of QuickBooks Capital's Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) product — from merchant/customer experience through funnel optimization and long\-term expansion. We're at an inflection point where AI is reshaping how financial products are built and experienced, and this role sits at the center of that transformation. We need a product lead who is deeply curious, moves with urgency, thrives in ambiguity, and can translate emerging capabilities into measurable outcomes for small businesses. Why Join Us? Impact at Scale: BNPL is a strategic new growth bet for QuickBooks Capital, one of the largest providers of financing for small businesses. Your work will shape how millions of small businesses and their customers access flexible payment options. Autonomy: You will own the BNPL product end\-to\-end with the freedom to drive bold bets, run experiments, and define the strategy. Culture: You'll join a team where the bar is high, the customer impact is real, and the opportunity to innovate is at a massive scale. And we have fun doing it! **Responsibilities** * Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for QuickBooks Capital's BNPL product, from customer acquisition, customer activation to checkout experience and performance measurement * Identify growth opportunities and innovate on the customer experience across the full funnel using AI to move faster, personalize at scale, and uncover insights * Define and launch bold new expansion strategies for BNPL to help fuel growth of the Intuit ecosystem * Champion the customer experience through deep empathy, research, and data * Lead cross\-functional partners from engineering to compliance to risk to ship delightful, intelligent, and responsible lending experiences for customers * Stay current with the AI landscape, including new model capabilities, emerging tools, and research and bring a point of view on how they apply to our customers **Qualifications** * 5\+ years designing and delivering world\-class products in a Product Management role, with a proven track record for results. Experience with growth and funnel\-optimization product management, and Fintech experience, strongly preferred. * Fluency with AI tools. You use them daily to research, analyze, prototype, and accelerate your work. Experience building or shipping AI\-powered product features is a plus. * Comfort with ambiguity. You can define the customer problem, set direction without a complete map, and make high\-quality decisions with imperfect information. * Relentless curiosity. You follow AI developments closely, experiment with new tools and models as they emerge, and have a tinkerer's instinct for what's possible. * Ownership mentality. You treat the product as yours, hold a high bar, and don't wait to be told what to do next. * Technically credible. you can hold substantive conversations with engineers about LLM trade\-offs, system design, and implementation complexity without needing to write the code yourself. * Bachelor's degree required. A major in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline is a plus Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview: Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. At Joby, we've been working to make that dream a reality since 2009 and we're now in the final stages of certifying our aircraft with the FAA. With plans to launch our aircraft in the US and Dubai, we're now scaling manufacturing and preparing for the launch of our commercial service. Overview: We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer with broad software experience and a strong AI focus to help bring production\-grade AI, computer vision, and automation capabilities into the systems that power Joby's manufacturing workflows. In this role, you'll partner closely with software engineers, product, operations, manufacturing, quality, and hardware teams to identify high\-impact opportunities, build reliable AI\-enabled services, and deploy vision systems that improve inspection, traceability, process monitoring, and decision support. Beyond individual projects, you'll help shape how AI is applied across the team, establishing the patterns and practices that let Factory Systems ship intelligent capabilities with confidence. You'll work in a fast\-moving, high\-ownership environment at the intersection of software, data, hardware, and aircraft manufacturing—where the output of your work directly improves how we build and scale. Responsibilities: * Identify, prototype, and deploy AI/ML and computer vision solutions that improve manufacturing workflows — use cases like visual inspection, anomaly detection, and traceability * Build reliable AI\-enabled services, APIs, and data pipelines that integrate internal systems, manufacturing equipment, and operational data * Build the safeguards that let AI operate in a real factory: measure model quality before and after deployment, and make sure a wrong prediction never silently propagates into a manufacturing decision * Own end\-to\-end delivery, from requirements discovery through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration * Raise the bar for the whole team by leading technical design discussions, mentoring engineers, and establishing the patterns and tooling that let others build and operate AI\-enabled features themselves Required: * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience * 5\+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems * Strong Python skills and experience building AI/ML, computer vision, or data\-intensive systems * Experience designing APIs, services, integrations, and maintainable system architectures * Experience moving prototypes into reliable production systems, with strong debugging, testing, and observability practices * Clear communication and a track record of collaborating across disciplines — hardware, operations, manufacturing, or quality — to deliver outcomes Desired: * Computer vision experience in object detection, segmentation, or image\-processing pipelines — ideally applied in manufacturing, robotics, or other hardware\-adjacent environments * Experience operating GPU compute for AI workloads — model serving, inference optimization or on\-prem/hybrid infrastructure * Familiarity with modern ML and LLM tooling: evaluation frameworks, labeling workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, or agentic workflow automation * Experience building internal tools or enterprise applications that integrate with manufacturing data systems and real\-time operational processes Additional Information: jobs.title: C++ Software Engineer
jobs.description: Josh.ai is a well\-funded early stage startup disrupting the smart home space. With a focus on voice control, Josh.ai offers exciting and challenging problems to tackle in the fields of AI, IoT, embedded software design, mobile development, and more. Scroll down to see current openings. Headquartered in Denver, CO Benefits \& Perks * Competitive Salary * Stock Options * Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits * Life and Disability Insurance * 401(k) Matching * Casual Dress Code and Atmosphere * Paid Parking * Free Smart Home Products * 9 Paid Holidays * 3\+ Weeks Vacation * Office Snacks * Company\-Sponsored Outings * Conference Opportunities * Matching Non\-Profit Donations C\+\+ Software Engineer #### **Overview:** At Josh.ai we are innovating at the intersection of home automation, voice control and artificial intelligence in order to create the world's most technologically advanced homes. We're a team of enthusiastic software engineers and UI/UX designers driven to change the way we interact with our living spaces. Using voice, natural user inputs, and best\-in\-class apps, Josh.ai makes it easy to control your whole home's TV and home theatre, music, lighting, shades, garage, locks, sprinklers, cameras, pool/hot tubs and more. #### **Responsibilities:** * Work in the Josh system to add core features across platform and application domains * Write device drivers and work on integrations with all our wonderful partners products * Regular communication, written and verbal, to work cross functionally with both backend and frontend development, UI/UX designers and others in the company * Identify system troubleshooting and deploy problem solving issues across platform and application domains * Contribute to architecture and recommend process improvements #### **Required Skills/Experience:** * 4\-year degree in computer science or a related field * 3 years professional experience in C\+\+ programming * Excellent interpersonal skills in communications, project management and problem solving skills #### **Preferred Skills:** * Experience with Go and/or Python * Experience with FreeRTOS or embedded systems * Interest and/or experience in the smart home automation movement * Comfortable with frequent incremental code testing and deployment * Knowledge of an agile team environment and processes, along with tools like GIT and JIRA Salary range: $100,000 \- $140,000\. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. and live in the Denver area To apply, please send us your resume and complete the short form at**http://josh.ai/developerjob****.** Please submit your resume to jobs@josh.ai.

jobs.title: IT Systems & Network Technician
jobs.description: **About KME** KME Technology Solutions is a managed service provider headquartered in Mount Laurel, NJ, supporting organizations across South Jersey, Delaware, and the Philadelphia metro area. Our clients include healthcare and dental practices, nonprofits, and local government — organizations that depend on us to keep their people productive and their data secure. We're a small, hands\-on team, and every engineer here has a direct impact on our clients and our growth. **The Role** We're looking for a Systems Engineer who is comfortable owning endpoints, servers, and networks end to end. You'll support KME's full client base, with a significant share of your time dedicated to one of our largest managed accounts, a multi\-site nonprofit organization. This is a field\-first role: you'll spend most of your week at client locations, solving problems in person and building relationships with the people you support. **Travel \& Work Location** * **Travel up to 5 days per week.** You'll travel to client sites anywhere in our service area, from Dover, DE to Trenton, NJ, including the Philadelphia metro and South Jersey. * **Typically onsite.** In most weeks, you will be working at a client location. * **Remote when not dispatched.** On days when no onsite dispatch is required, you'll have the opportunity to work remotely. * **Reliable transportation.** A valid driver's license, clean driving record, and reliable personal vehicle are required. **What You'll Do** * Provide Tier 2 support for endpoints, servers, and network infrastructure across multiple client environments * Serve as a primary onsite and remote resource for a large multi\-site nonprofit client * Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP * Manage Microsoft 365 tenants, including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Intune, Teams, and SharePoint * Configure and troubleshoot Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, VPN (IPsec and SSL), switching, VLANs, and wireless * Support VMware vSphere environments, including host and VM maintenance * Deploy, image, patch, and secure Windows endpoints using our RMM platform (NinjaOne) * Monitor and respond to alerts, backup failures, and security events; remediate or escalate as needed * Work tickets through to resolution with clear notes and timely client communication * Document configurations, procedures, and client environments in IT Glue * Contribute to projects such as server migrations, network refreshes, VPN migrations, and M365 rollouts **What You Bring** * 3\+ years of hands\-on IT experience in a systems or network support role (MSP experience strongly preferred) * Solid working knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory * Experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID * Practical networking skills: TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, VPN, firewall policy, and wireless * Experience with virtualization (VMware preferred) * Strong troubleshooting instincts and the ability to work independently in the field * Professional, client\-facing communication skills; comfortable explaining technical issues to non\-technical users * Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and reliable transportation **Nice to Have** * Fortinet NSE certifications or hands\-on FortiGate / FortiClient experience * Cisco Meraki experience * CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+, CCNA, or Microsoft certifications (MD\-102, MS\-102, AZ\-104\) * Experience with NinjaOne, IT Glue, or similar RMM and documentation platforms * Experience supporting healthcare, dental, nonprofit, or government environments, including HIPAA awareness * Unifi Experience Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Field Regulatory Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. Keysight is seeking a highly motivated **Field Regulatory Engineer** to join the Product Environmental \& Regulatory Compliance (PERCS) team within Customer Experience \& Quality (CE\&Q). This role is responsible for supporting Keysight's regulatory compliance and market access activities across the **United States, Canada, and Latin America**. The successful candidate will serve as a key interface between regulators, certification agencies, business units, R\&D teams, manufacturing partners, quality organizations, and customers to ensure Keysight products continue to meet applicable regional regulatory requirements. The role will develop pragmatic compliance strategies through the following activities: Monitor and influence evolving regulations, coordinate and assist certification activities, provide regulatory guidance to Keysight Hardware Test Center (HTC) staff and supplier quality aligned with Keysight’s market access needs. This position contributes directly to CE\&Q priorities related to regulatory evolution, business continuity, product compliance, customer support, and supplier compliance. Responsibilities: **Key Responsibilities** **Regulatory Compliance Management** * Lead regulatory compliance activities supporting product market access across the United States, Canada, and Latin America. * Interpret, influence and communicate emerging regulatory requirements and assess their impact on Keysight products and services. * Provide regulatory guidance to HTC’s and supplier quality teams. * Support M\&A compliance assessments. * Participate in industry associations, standards committees, and regulatory working groups, as appropriate. **Certification \& Market Access** * Manage relationships with external regulators, testing organizations, and certification providers. * Coordinate surveillance activities with regulatory agencies, and certification bodies. * Point of escalation for compliance with the CSA requirement. **Customer \& Business Support** * Consult and advise on customer inquiries related to regulatory compliance, certifications, and product approvals. * Support sales teams, contract reviews, and customer questionnaires requiring regulatory expertise. * Partner with Legal, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and Product Divisions to address compliance\-related issues. **Compliance Process Improvement** * Drive continuous improvement of regulatory compliance processes, tools, and reporting mechanisms. * Leverage digital tools, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions to improve operational efficiency. * Support CE\&Q operational metrics, business continuity planning, and succession readiness initiatives. **Vendor Management** * Coordinate objectives, activities, and project improvements for Business owned applications * Manage relationships with outsource services, trade associations, and NRTL. * Budgeting, spend tracking and quarterly projections for each of the partners above. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Electronics Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline. * Advanced degree preferred. **Experience** * 10\+ years of experience in product regulatory compliance, certification, quality, or engineering roles. * Experience supporting market access and regulatory compliance in the United States, Canada, and/or Latin America. * Demonstrated experience working with regulatory agencies, certification bodies, and trade associations. * Experience managing compliance projects across multiple product lines and business functions. **Technical Skills** * Strong understanding of product regulatory compliance frameworks and approval processes. * Knowledge of product safety, EMC, telecommunications, wireless, environmental, or related regulatory requirements. * Strong project management and stakeholder management skills. * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication abilities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with North American and Latin American regulatory agencies and certification schemes. * Familiarity with standards development processes and industry committees. * Experience within electronics, instrumentation, telecommunications, industrial, or technology sectors. * Working knowledge of quality systems, business management systems, and lifecycle management processes. **Key Competencies** * Regulatory expertise and sound judgement * Ai Mindset * Technical leadership * Cross\-functional collaboration * Customer focus * Strategic thinking * Communication and influencing skills * Continuous improvement mindset * Ability to work effectively across global teams and cultures **Note:** For other locations, pay ranges will vary by region. This role is eligible for Keysight's Variable Pay Bonus Program US Employees may be eligible for the following benefits:* Medical, dental and vision * Health Savings Account * Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts * Life, Accident, Disability insurance * Business Travel Accident and Business Travel Health * 401(k) Plan * Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays * Paid Family Leave * Discounts, Perks * Tuition Reimbursement * Adoption Assistance * ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan) * Restricted Stock Units Loveland, CO and Colorado Springs, CO Pay Range: MIN $132,000\.00 \- MAX $220,000\.00 Santa Rosa, CA Pay Range: MIN $143,000\.00 \- MAX $238,000\.00 \#LI\-MO1 Careers Privacy Statement ***\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\**** Keysight Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws. Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

jobs.title: Electrical Estimator - Industrial/Power Construction 1
jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 182453 **Job Level:** Senior Level **Home District/Group:** Industrial Market **Department:** Estimating **Market:** Industrial **Employment Type:** Full Time **Position Overview** --------------------- The Electrical Estimator is responsible for overseeing the preparation of accurate and comprehensive cost estimates for construction projects. This role involves coordinating with various departments, analyzing project requirements, and ensuring that all estimates are aligned with company standards and client expectations. The Lead Estimator plays a crucial role in the bidding process, helping the company secure profitable projects while maintaining competitive pricing. **District Overview** --------------------- Mass. Electric Construction Co. (MEC) is a subsidiary of the Kiewit Corporation, since our founding in 1928 in Boston, Massachusetts, Mass. Electric Construction’s philosophy has been to pursue electrical projects that require a higher level of technical and logistical skill. MEC has organized strategically to actively participate and capture projects in the growing industrial market. We intend to effectively compete and win in traditional and alternate delivery procurements and position ourselves for a sustainable future. We self\-perform the majority of our work and are looking for people committed to the industrial construction industry. **Location** ------------ This position can be based in our Irvine, CA or Waltham, MA office. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Implement and oversee district estimating program and activities including the development of policies and procedures. * Assist district manager in the review of all estimates; arrange and coordinate second estimates, maintain past cost history and comparable details. * Maintain training program for estimating staff, update and maintain lead estimator and sponsor manuals, and supervise district scheduling department. * Maintain district standards for control budgets and develop project level staffing plan to ensure the project has adequate support after award. * Coordinate with the business development department in the preparation of proposal documents. * Ensure training of all new graduates is scheduled for engineers in estimating and Field Engineer duties. * Provide estimating support for numerous projects, perform quantity takeoffs, and solicit, evaluate, and incorporate vendor or manufacturer material and subcontract pricing. * Prepare recaps, pricing sheets, bid forms, and other proposal documents for in\-house review and bid submittal. \#LI\-JT1 **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of estimating experience • Familiarity with power feeders, controls and signal systems for industrial applications. • Experience in estimating industrial electrical installations, such as water/wastewater treatment facilities, refineries, and battery storage facilities. • Strong work ethic and interpersonal, organizational, and leadership skills • Ability to work on a team as well as work independently with little or no supervision • Experience with standard office computer software • Experience with Accubid Anywhere and Bluebeam is preferred. • Results\-oriented with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities • Ability to travel when necessary for pre\-bid job walks and bid reviews • Bachelor’s degree in engineering with an emphasis in civil, mechanical, or electrical engineering is preferred but not a pre\-requisite. Other Requirements: * Regular, reliable attendance * Work productively and meet deadlines timely * Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment * Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies. * Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required. Base Compensation: $115,000/yr \- $145,000/yr (Actual compensation is subject to variation due to such factors as education, experience, skillset, and/or location) We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top\-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off. Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: CAD Operator - Water/Wastewater
jobs.description: Overview: Kimley\-Horn is looking for an experienced CAD Operator to join our Water Wastewater and Utilities team in Fort Myers, Florida (FL)! This is not a remote position. Responsibilities: * You will be working closely with the project engineer or designer utilizing Autodesk Civil 3D, and Revit to create civil construction documents for wastewater lift stations, pump stations, pipelines and utility work. * This person will develop technical drawings and plans using CAD software * The person in this position will make and quality check drawings and plans of substantial complexity and may perform some multifaceted calculations * Requires minimal supervision to perform day to day tasks * Has knowledge of engineering principles and suggests design changes * Maintains drawing database * May supervise and train CAD staff * Coordinates work activities to maintain schedules and ensure quality control * Develop familiarity with Kimley\-Horn’s practices, procedures, and standards Qualifications: * High school diploma or equivalent (associates degree preferred) * 3\+ years of relevant experience * Advanced knowledge and proficiency in Autodesk or Bentley products * Detail oriented, professional attitude, good communication, team player, self\-starter * Strong work ethic, interpersonal communication/writing skills and desire to learn * Ability to work independently and with a team Why Kimley\-Horn?: At Kimley\-Horn, we do things differently. People, clients, and employees are at the forefront of who we are. Clients know we prioritize achieving their goals and growing their success. Employees know our culture and approach to business are built on a desire to provide an environment for everyone to flourish. Our commitment to quality is only as good as the people behind it— that’s why we welcome and develop passionate, hardworking, and proactive employees. We take pride in how our employee retention, robust benefits package, and company values have led to Kimley\-Horn’s placement on the Fortune “100 Best Companies to Work” list for 19 years! *Key Benefits at Kimley\-Horn** Exceptional Retirement Plan: 2\-to1\- company match on up to 4% of eligible compensation (salary \+ bonus) and additional profit\-sharing contribution. * Comprehensive Health Coverage: Low\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance options. * Time Off: Personal leave, flexible scheduling, floating holidays, and half\-day Fridays. * Financial Wellness: Student loan matching in our 401(k), and performance\-based bonuses. * Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement and extensive internal training programs. * Family\-Friendly Benefits: New Parent Leave, family building benefits, and childcare resources.
