jobs.title: Estimator II
jobs.description: Overview: The **Estimator** plays a critical role in shaping the future success of major EPC projects by leading the development of complex, high\-value conceptual estimates and competitive bid strategies. Leveraging deep industry expertise and strong commercial acumen, this position transforms early project concepts into accurate, executable cost models that drive sound business decisions and winning pursuits. Reporting to the Estimating Manager, the Estimator serves as a key leader within their assigned service line, providing strategic estimating guidance across targeted industries and markets. This role takes ownership of all aspects of major project pursuits, including RFP analysis, estimate development, proposal strategy, alternative contracting approaches, and risk assessment. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, the Estimator helps position the organization for success by identifying opportunities, mitigating risks, and delivering compelling, competitive solutions that align with client objectives and company growth goals. **Location \& Travel Details: Preference for candidates living in the Denver, CO area or Vancouver, WA region.** This is can be a hybrid or remote role. We serve a diverse clientele, including utilities, independent power producers, developers, and municipal utilities. Specializing in projects using natural gas, oil, biomass, and other combustible fuels, our team boasts over 30 years of expertise in the power industry. We provide EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) services and assist in project development. Our experience spans various systems for utility and industrial facilities, including simple and combined cycle plants, reciprocating engines, and waste\-to\-energy projects. MasTec Industrial delivers value throughout all project phases, from conceptual design to operations and maintenance. Our goal is to foster a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in the industry. The MasTec Industrial market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy \& Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy \& Infrastructure (CE\&I) segment generates over $4 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. In addition to our industrial market sector; In infrastructure, we specialize in general heavy civil construction, underground utilities, structures, electrical work, material production, roadways, bridges, specialty pavement overlays, environmental projects and commercial buildings. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority\-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. Responsibilities: **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Prepare accurate quantity surveys and estimates for those divisions of the project as assigned * Complete assignments in agreed upon time frame * Solicit subcontractor and/or supplier quotations or scheduling input as required for the assignments * Participate in plan review and estimate reviews for respective projects * Assist in compiling historical cost data for projects * Confirm list of subcontractors/suppliers proposing on the project * Collaborate with Architects/Engineers to request clarifications or additional information * Attend project meetings and perform site investigations as assigned * Become familiar with all estimating software **Lead Estimator Designation:** When the Estimator is designated as the Lead Estimator on an estimate, the following additional responsibilities will be required:* Supervise and line out all people on the bid team, provide adequate information to team members and establish bidding schedule with deadlines. * Assure successful kick off meetings, mid\-bid reviews, and final reviews. Get the Regional VP of Operations involved if they are available. * Review and understand owner provided specifications and documentation for all portions of the work and ensure the needed costs have been incorporated into the estimate. * Perform final reviews at least two (2\) days before bid due date. * Review all work performed by team members. * Critically analyze each aspect of the estimate to ensure a competitive bid. Apply appropriate labor rates and methods of construction based on provided information and expected site conditions. Explore options which could shorten the construction schedules and minimize indirects and construction equipment. Recognize risks and apply contingency and escalation when appropriate. Know when and how to capitalize on opportunities. jobs.title: Senior Algorithm Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** PASCALL is a growing multidisciplinary medical device company building an FDA\-cleared, EEG\-based brain state monitoring platform — a wearable EEG sensor paired with an Android tablet application — now in active clinical use. As our platform matures and enters more hospitals, we are hiring a Senior Algorithm Engineer to lead the development of the signal processing and machine learning models at the core of the product. We are looking for a self\-motivated engineer and scientist who treats an open problem as an invitation — someone who invents, prototypes, and champions ideas that create measurable business value. This is a hands\-on, technically deep role based in Cambridge, working closely with our CEO, our product team, and our device/hardware team. You'll own algorithm development end\-to\-end: from feature extraction and artifact removal through to real\-time state estimation, validated and documented to the standard required for a regulated medical device. PASCALL actively uses agentic AI tools to accelerate development, documentation, and algorithm research. We welcome engineers who are comfortable experimenting with AI\-assisted workflows and applying them responsibly in a regulated environment. In addition, because the team is small and much of the algorithm roadmap is still being written, you will have unusual latitude to shape what gets built. We invite you to bring creative approaches to problems that have no established answer and to argue for the bets you believe in. **Responsibilities** * **Design and Own Signal Processing Algorithms:** Develop and refine algorithms for feature extraction, artifact removal and parameter estimation from EEG signals, spanning statistical time\-series methods, control\-engineering approaches and state\-space modeling. * **Build Real\-Time, Deployable Estimators:** Design sequential, real\-time algorithms — including Kalman filtering and related recursive estimation techniques — that run reliably on the device in live clinical settings. * **Advance the Brain State Platform:** Drive the next generation of brain\-state estimation and related algorithm deliverables, working across the full path from research prototype to shipped, validated feature. * **Lead Regulated Algorithm Development:** Define, write, and validate algorithms under PASCALL's Quality Management System, producing the documentation, verification, and validation evidence needed for FDA submissions in partnership with Quality and Regulatory. * **Use AI\-assisted tools** (e.g., LLM\-powered coding assistants, automated documentation) to accelerate development tasks. * **Apply AI tools responsibly** within PASCALL's regulated development environment. * **Mentor and Set Technical Direction:** Provide technical leadership to the algorithm team, review designs and code and help set the standards other engineers build against. * **Collaborate Across Disciplines:** Partner closely with the device/hardware, software, and clinical teams to ensure algorithms perform correctly in real\-time and reflect real clinical needs. * **Solve Hard Problems:** Investigate and root\-cause complex, intermittent issues across the signal path — from sensor to algorithm output — bringing inventive, unconventional approaches when the obvious path is blocked. * **Innovate on the Product:** Prototype new ideas quickly, propose approaches nobody has asked for, and think past the current architecture about what the platform's algorithms could do for clinicians, hospitals and the business. **Qualifications** **Education** * Advanced degree (PhD) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computational Neuroscience, Biomedical or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computational Biology or a related field. **Experience and Skills** * 5\+ years of industry experience developing signal processing or machine learning algorithms for production\-level systems. Medical device or other regulated industry experience strongly preferred. * Strong command of statistical signal processing, including time\-series and frequency\-domain/spectral analysis. * Strong command of biomedical signal processing, including control engineering, state\-space modeling, * sequential algorithms and Kalman filtering. * Strong coder in Python with solid scientific engineering practices (you write reusable modules and libraries and use OOP where it makes sense). * Comfort using AI\-assisted tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude / Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor) for coding and research. * Versatility and initiative: \*\*\*\*you can take an ambiguous, high\-level objective, scope it yourself, and run it to completion and you look for the next problem rather than waiting to be assigned one. * Creativity and independent drive: \*\*\*\*a track record of thinking outside the box — finding a simpler algorithmic approach, repurposing a technique in an unexpected way, or solving something others had accepted as fixed and the self\-motivation to pursue it without being asked. * Commercial instinct: \*\*\*\*you understand how algorithm choices translate into customer adoption, regulatory timelines and revenue and can prioritize accordingly. * Clear communications: you are comfortable working across an interdisciplinary team of engineers, neuroscientists, and physicians. * Documentation rigor: \*\*\*\*you have the discipline to document algorithms, decisions and validation evidence precisely. **Preferred** * Software engineering experience and knowledge of best practices. * Direct experience developing a medical device or working under an FDA QSR\- or ISO 13485\-certified Quality Management System. * Experience with AWS managed services, cloud computing and MLOps. * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) responsibly in a regulated environment. * Evidence of building something of your own — \*\*\*\*a side project, an internal tool that spread, a patent, a publication, or a product idea you took from sketch to something real. **About PASCALL Systems** PASCALL is a Cambridge\-based medical device company focused on advancing neuroscience\-based personalized anesthesia monitoring. Our team includes leading academic and clinical experts from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, and Massachusetts General Hospital. We achieved ISO 13485 certification for medical device design and development and received FDA 510(k) clearance for our first platform system in 2022\. We are now building the next generation of EEG\-based brain state algorithms to improve anesthesia care and patient outcomes worldwide. We are a small team solving problems that do not have textbook answers, and we give engineers real ownership over the direction of the product. Our vision is to bring personalized, science\-based anesthesia care to all patients. **How to Apply** In your Cover Letter, answer each of the following questions clearly: **1\.** What excites you about this role and PASCALL's mission? **2\.** Tell us about a technical project you are most proud of — ideally one involving signal processing, state estimation, or algorithm development under real\-world constraints. **3\.** Tell us about something you invented, prototyped, or improved that nobody asked you to build — what made you pursue it, and what value did it create? Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid parental leave * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge, MA 02139 Compensation Range: $130K \- $150K

Nice to Have * Hands\-on experience with healthcare interoperability standards — HL7 v2, FHIR, and related messaging/transport patterns. * Direct experience integrating a device or software product with hospital systems (Philips Capsule, Epic Bridges/Interconnect, Cerner, or similar), or familiarity with clinical IT governance and hospital security review processes. **About PASCALL Systems** PASCALL is a Cambridge\-based medical device company focused on advancing neuroscience\-based personalized anesthesia monitoring. Our team includes leading academic and clinical experts from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, and Massachusetts General Hospital. We achieved ISO 13485 certification for medical device design and development and received FDA 510(k) clearance for our first platform system in 2022\. We are now building the next generation of EEG\-based brain state algorithms to improve anesthesia care and patient outcomes worldwide. Our vision is to bring personalized, science\-based anesthesia care to all patients. **How to Apply** *In your Cover Letter, answer each of the following questions clearly:* * What excites you about this role and PASCALL's mission? * Tell us about a time you worked directly with a customer, partner, or external technical team to get software deployed in their environment. * Tell us about something you invented, prototyped, or improved that nobody asked you to build — what made you pursue it, and what value did it create? jobs.title: IT Support Engineer - Central Arkansas
jobs.description: At Pediatrics Plus, we are looking for an **IT Support Engineer** to join our team! Pediatrics Plus is a specialized pediatric healthcare provider. We are committed to helping children succeed in all stages of life through evidence\-based therapy and education, diagnostic services, state\-of\-the\-art facilities, specialized equipment, family support, and community investment. **What we offer:** * Competitive Pay * Paid Time Off * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Insurance * State of the Art Facilities \& Technology **What you will do**: The IT Support Engineer will install, troubleshoot, maintain, and support hardware, software, and technology systems throughout the company. They provide experienced technical support to team members both remotely and onsite at Pediatrics Plus locations. The IT Support Engineer will regularly travel to Pediatrics Plus locations to provide both reactive technical support and proactive maintenance, helping ensure technology is reliable and operating effectively across the company. **Hardware and Device Support** * Set ups, configures, maintains, and troubleshoots computers, monitors, printers, mobile devices, and other technology equipment. * Diagnoses and resolves hardware and peripheral issues. * Assists with deployment and replacement of technology equipment. **Software and User Support** * Troubleshoots Microsoft applications, operating systems, remote access, and other business applications. * Manages users, passwords, permissions, and basic configurations in Active Directory and Microsoft 365\. * Installs, configures, updates, and troubleshoots software applications. * Provides technical assistance to team members both remotely and onsite. **Network and Systems Support** * Troubleshoots common network and connectivity issues. * Assists with wireless, printer, and network troubleshooting. * Escalates more complex server, network, security, and infrastructure issues to the appropriate IT team member. * Assists senior IT staff and outside providers with system maintenance and technology projects. **Help Desk and Customer Service** * Tracks, prioritizes, monitors, and resolves tickets in the ticketing system. * Handles technical issues independently when within the scope of the role. * Recognizes when an issue requires escalation and communicates relevant information to the appropriate resource. * Provides excellent customer service and communicates technical information clearly to non\-technical team members. **Clinic and Field Support** * Regularly travels to Pediatrics Plus locations within approximately a two\-hour driving radius to provide onsite IT support. * Responds to technology issues that require onsite troubleshooting and resolution. * Conducts proactive visits to Pediatrics Plus locations to identify and address potential technology issues before they impact operations. * Installs, configures, replaces, and troubleshoots computers, printers, network\-connected devices, and other technology equipment at Pediatrics Plus locations. * Builds strong working relationships with leadership and team members and serve as a trusted onsite IT resource. * Coordinates with other IT team members and outside providers when issues require additional technical expertise. * Documents work performed, equipment changes, and unresolved issues following site visits. **IT Operations** * Tracks and monitors technology inventory. * Maintains accurate documentation of equipment, systems, and common support procedures. * Assists with new team member technology setup and team member offboarding. * Identifies recurring technical issues and recommends practical improvements. * Communicates effectively with outside contractors and technology providers. **General** * Upholds and incorporates the core values, mission, and philosophy of Pediatrics Plus into all job responsibilities. * Participates in one\-on\-one meetings with leader. * Works collaboratively with other members of the IT team and departments throughout the company. * Performs other related and non\-related duties as assigned. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* **What you have:** * Strong technical troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently resolve common hardware, software, user account, and connectivity issues. * Working knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft applications. * Basic understanding of Active Directory, Microsoft 365, networking, and server environments. * Ability to recognize when an issue should be escalated to a more senior technical resource. * Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy. * Ability to manage multiple support requests and prioritize work appropriately. * Ability to independently manage a schedule that includes both planned location visits and unplanned/reactive support needs. * Strong customer service skills and ability to work effectively with non\-technical team members. * Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with a wide variety of people. * Ability to document technical issues and solutions clearly. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. * Ability to complete tasks in a timely manner. * Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance. * Travel will be required. Must possess a valid driver's license in the state of Arkansas and maintain an acceptable driving record. **Education/Certification/Experience:** * High school diploma or equivalent, required. * Associate or college degree, preferred. * Technical training or relevant certifications, preferred. * 3\+ years of IT support experience, preferred. * Demonstrated experience troubleshooting Windows computers, software applications, printers, and peripheral devices. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Active Directory environments, preferred. * Experience troubleshooting basic networking and connectivity issues. **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the team member is frequently required to accurately communicate information and ideas so others will understand through sight and hearing. The team member is regularly required to move including walking, running, jumping, and sitting. The team member is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, lift, reach, and feel. jobs.title: Junior Backend Systems Engineer (Python/C++)
jobs.description: We are seeking a detail\-oriented, highly analytical Junior Systems Software Engineer to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize low\-level application architecture, networking protocols, and performance\-critical systems. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, hands\-on experience with C\+\+ and Python, and a passion for building responsive, scalable software. **Key Responsibilities:** · **Systems \& Network Architecture:** Design, implement, and maintain custom networking components, client\-server models, and protocol resolvers (UDP/TCP, DNS, socket communications). · **Algorithm \& Performance Optimization:** Apply data structures, memory management, and graph search heuristics (e.g., A\*, custom hashing, priority queues) to solve complex performance and indexing challenges. · **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Develop and execute comprehensive unit, integration, and stress tests to validate network state synchronization, catch edge cases, and eliminate execution bottlenecks. · **Debugging \& Problem Solving:** Utilize low\-level debugging tools (GDB, Wireshark) to trace memory leaks, analyze packet flow, and debug asynchronous multi\-threaded or multi\-client execution paths. · **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with cross\-functional teams to design clean, modular codebases and maintain version control integrity across all release cycles. **Key Requirements:** · **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline (GPA 3\.5\+ preferred). · **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in **C\+\+** and **Python** . Familiarity with C, C\#, Java, SQL, or x86 Assembly is a plus. · **Systems \& Networking:** Solid understanding of TCP/UDP networking principles, socket programming, caching mechanisms, operating systems, and computer architecture. · **Tools \& Environment:** Hands\-on experience with **Linux/Bash** , **Git/GitHub** , **GDB** , and **Wireshark** . Experience with SFML, Unity, or VR/AR engines is desirable. · **CS Fundamentals:** Proven command of object\-oriented design, algorithmic complexity, recursive problem\-solving, and concurrent state management. **Desired Competencies:** · Self\-starter capable of managing end\-to\-end projects—from requirement mapping to comprehensive testing. · Passion for interactive media, high\-performance computing, or game engine mechanics. · Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and code reviews.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description: **Introduction** Are you searching for an opportunity to play a key role in contributing to the dramatic growth of a highly successful software company? At Poppulo, we're working on what's next in communications and workplace technology. As a recognised organisation in this industry, we understand that meaningfully reaching every employee is hard. And so is managing office space in a hybrid world. And so is improving the customer and guest experience. We exist to make each of these things easier. We exist to bring harmony to our customers. And we do that at enterprise scale. Our omnichannel employee communications, customer communications, and workplace experience platform is trusted by over 6,000 organisations today, reaching more than 35M employees and delivering content to 500,000\+ digital signs. We know there's no such thing as a "perfect" candidate \- we're all a work in progress and are growing new skills and capabilities all the time. We encourage you to apply for a position with Poppulo even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements. We believe in fostering an environment where there is a diversity of perspectives, in hopes that we can all succeed. **Job Summary** Poppulo is expanding its global Customer Success Engineering team, and this role adds capacity in US to support our US and global customer base. Customer Success Engineers are the technical owners of the customer relationship after the sale, working alongside Customer Success Managers to turn a signed contract into launched, adopted, measurable outcomes, and then to keep those outcomes compounding through every renewal that follows. The work is hands\-on and outcome led. You will get customers to real adoption of what they have bought and then look for the pattern behind it: the playbook, the reusable asset, the piece of enablement that lets the next twenty customers reach the same outcome without twenty separate engagements. Some accounts will fund dedicated coverage and expect an embedded engineer; most you will cover across a wider portfolio, deciding where your time matters most based on retention risk and expansion opportunity. Where a customer buys a scoped implementation or a significant build, our Professional Services team delivers it and you pick up the ongoing technical ownership from there, so the customer keeps a consistent technical partner long after the project closes. Success is measured by adoption and gross revenue retention across the accounts you cover, not by hours logged, tickets closed, or billable delivery. You will be central when an escalation or a critical implementation demands deep technical help, but much of your impact should come from customers succeeding before anyone has to escalate, and from the scaled approaches that make that repeatable. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the technical relationship for an assigned set of accounts, partnering with the Customer Success Manager who owns the commercial relationship, so the customer experiences one team rather than a series of handoffs. * Drive measurable adoption across your accounts: define what a successful technical outcome looks like, track whether the customer is reaching it, and intervene early when the signals turn. * Work directly in customer environments to configure and optimize Poppulo experiences, accelerating time to value new adoption and deepening usage of what is already live. * Deliver enablement and training that makes customer admins and content owners more self\-sufficient as needed to protect revenue * Prioritize across a portfolio, making judgement calls on where technical attention will most reduce churn risk or unlock expansion, and time boxing engagements against a clear reason for being there. * Step in as the technical lead during escalations and critical situations, coordinating support to a resolution the customer can see, while working to reduce how often those situations arise. * Surface expansion opportunities uncovered through technical work, qualifying new use cases and handing them to the commercial team with the technical case already made. * Partner closely with Professional Services on scoped implementations and build projects: contribute to the account context going in and take on continuous technical ownership once the project is delivered. * Work as part of a globally distributed Customer Success Engineering team, sharing coverage, context, and escalation support across regions and time zones. * Represent the customer's technical reality internally, feeding defects, gaps, and roadmap needs into Product and Engineering with the evidence to make them actionable. * Build the scaled approaches that extend your reach: reusable playbooks, reference configurations, enablement of assets, and repeatable interventions that lift outcomes across many accounts rather than one at a time. **Technical Skills / Competencies** * 4\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role such as success engineering, solutions engineering, technical  technical outcomes for enterprise customers beyond initial launch, rather than project delivery and handover. * Experience working across multiple accounts simultaneously and prioritising independently. * Working knowledge of enterprise technical infrastructure: SSO and identity management, APIs and integrations, web technologies, security and industry compliance. * Experience contributing to retention or expansion outcomes, whether formally measured or through influence on renewals. * Proven ability to learn new technologies independently and become productive quickly. * Third\-level qualification in a technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Technical Skills / Competencies** * **Driving adoption and technical outcomes.** Able to define what success looks like inside an account, get the customer there, and evidence it. Judged on whether the customer is genuinely using and valuing the platform, not on activity delivered. * **Building for scale.** Instinctively turns a solved problem into a playbook, reference configuration, or enablement asset, so the next customer benefits without a repeat engagement. * **Hands\-on technical capability in enterprise SaaS.** Comfortable configuring within a platform, working with APIs and integrations, and troubleshooting across enterprise infrastructure including SSO and access management, web technologies, security, and compliance. * **Portfolio judgement.** Can hold many accounts at once and decide independently where technical attention creates the most value, without waiting to be assigned. * **Credible communication at every level.** Can train an admin in the morning and hold a candid technical conversation with an enterprise executive in the afternoon, adjusting depth without losing authority. **Compensation** **Annual base salary gross: 70,000\-100,000** plus variable USD Annual. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Company's contemplated salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and geographic location. The salary is one component of Company's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include variable compensation, short\-term incentives, health insurance, accident and life insurance, access to the best in class learning and development platforms, flexible work arrangement, to name just a few! **Who We Are** We are a values\-driven organisation that encourages our employees to bring their authentic selves to work every day and empowers everyone to make a tangible impact on our products, clients, and culture. We offer a dynamic environment with driven, fun, and flexible individuals who thrive on challenge and responsibility. This is an opportunity to contribute to our culture and join a company that's on the move. We live the Poppulo values each day, as they are key to everything we do. * **Bring Your Best Self** We show up authentically, are self\-aware and always strive to be better. * **See it. Own it. Solve it.** We proactively innovate and solve for our customers and each other. We set an example with high standards for our work. We foster a culture of learning, acknowledging our successes and our failures. * **Together We're Better** We value and celebrate our diversity. We learn from others, respecting their expertise, and focus on building trust. That's what makes us a team. Named a Great Place to Work in 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021, we are a fast\-growing global technology company, with offices in Ireland, the US, the UK. and India. Poppulo is an equal opportunity employer. *We are committed to protecting your privacy. For details on how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please refer to our* ***Job Applicant Privacy Policy****. Please also review* ***AI in Our Hiring Process*** *for information on our approach to AI in hiring and guidance for candidates.*

Build and manage data cataloguing and metadata management systems. Design and implement data governance policies and procedures. Ensure data security, privacy and compliance with relevant regulations. * **Monitoring and Performance Optimization:** Implement advanced monitoring and observability solutions to track the performance and health of infrastructure and data pipelines. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The problem we've solved Selling has always run on a brutal ratio. A salesperson spends barely a third of their day actually selling. The other two\-thirds goes to the work around the customer: the research, the lists, the notes, the CRM, the follow\-up. Two\-thirds of every sales payroll dollar buys administration instead of revenue. The manager's ratio is worse. Coaching is the highest\-leverage thing a sales manager does and it's structurally impossible to do at scale, so they sit in on one call a week and guess at the rest while the quiet underperformers repeat the same mistakes on real customers every day. We built the platform that ends both ratios. One system: the humans get coached on every call they make, and an AI coworker absorbs everything that comes with selling but isn't selling, wired into the CRM, the phones, and the calendar the business already runs on. The hours come back, every conversation gets better, and every outcome feeds back into what gets coached and absorbed next. More time, spent better, measured against revenue. The thing worth understanding before you apply: the call itself is about to be free. Within a year every voice model will hold a competent conversation. What lasts is what happens after the agent hangs up, the messy conversation turned into clean structured data, landed in the system the customer already works in, with the reasoning attached and proof it was done right. Anyone can make the call. Almost nobody does the finishing. That finishing is the product, it's deep, unglamorous, customer\-specific work that doesn't get copied over a weekend, and it's already running. It's also most of what this role extends into every new account. The role We need one person to own the technical customer journey end to end: first serious conversation to live in production. Demo, discovery, pilot design, CRM and telephony integration, launch, and support. You'll go into the codebase when a deployment demands it, tuning and extending what's already there so it fits each new customer, and turning what you learn in the field back into the product. This is the hire that stands up our go\-to\-market motion. You won't inherit a process. You'll build one, run it on our first accounts, and make it repeatable enough that the tenth deployment is dramatically easier than the first. Why this role exists The product is built and it works. The two founders ship production code across the platform, and it's live and running today. What we don't yet have is someone who has run an enterprise technical sales cycle and can deploy that product into outside customers reliably. That's the gap this hire fills, and it's the difference between a product that works and a company that sells. We're not looking for a cog. We're looking for the person who owns the commercial engine and teaches the founders the cycle along the way, so the motion lives in the company and not in one person's head. The unfair advantage you're walking into We own and operate a mid\-sized business in our beachhead vertical. The platform is deployed and running inside that operation right now, with real reps, real call volume, real CRM, and real revenue on the line. It was battle\-tested against a business we own before it ever went near an outside account. You are not selling vapor and you are not cold\-starting in an empty category. You're taking something proven in production into a market we know cold. The size of it The beachhead is one vertical, deliberately. But the architecture doesn't care which vertical it's in. The same system, humans coached on the calls that stay human, a coworker taking the volume and the routine events, wired into whatever stack the customer already runs, applies to any floor where the phone is where the revenue happens: distribution, staffing, mortgage, real estate, dealer groups, legal intake, and beyond. And it runs in two directions. On the floor it's the best software a sales team has ever used. On the wire it's infrastructure the customer's own systems call over API when an event fires. That second direction is where the ceiling stops tracking headcount and starts tracking transaction volume. You'd be deploying the first outside proof of a motion that's meant to stamp across an entire market. Where we are The product is live and proven inside our own operation. Outside customers are the frontier you'd be hired to open, so you're employee\-level early, with the ownership and the upside that implies. If you want a mature pipeline handed to you, this isn't it. If you want to be the person who builds it on top of a product that already works, it's exactly it. What you'll own * **Win the customer.** Lead demos and technical discovery with sales leaders, RevOps, and executives. Turn "we use Salesforce and RingCentral" into a real deployment plan. A good demo leaves them thinking this understands how our team actually works. * **Deploy the customer.** CRM integration and write\-back, telephony setup, configuration, end\-to\-end validation. A phone number that shows connected is not enough. You own the test call. An API that connects is not an integration. It's done when the right data lands in the right place and the customer trusts it. * **Design pilots that answer business questions,** not pilots that succeed because people liked the demo. Baseline metrics, instrumentation, clear success criteria, escalation path. * **Tune and extend the product in the field.** Fix the CRM sync, trace the voice defect, close the integration gap, adapt the finishing to a new customer's stack. You own problems through the stack, not up to the edge of a title. * **Turn the field into product.** When three customers need the same thing, the job isn't to configure it three times. It's to see the pattern and help turn it into a platform capability. * **Transfer the motion.** Part of this role is teaching the founders to run discovery and demos without you in the room. Making yourself repeatable is a measure of success here, not a threat to your seat. The stack Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node, Supabase/Postgres, Inngest for durable async workflows, Electron for live\-call experiences. Voice runs over PSTN with realtime AI: ASR, LLM reasoning, TTS, warm transfers, escalation. You don't need every piece on day one. You need to move through the stack without a tour guide and know where the deterministic boundaries have to sit around the AI. What we look for * You've run enterprise technical sales cycles: discovery, demos to executives, pilots, RFP responses, real integrations. * You can ship production code (TypeScript/Node/React/Postgres) and own a deployment end to end. * You've put AI into production and can reason about agents, tools, evaluation, state, and human escalation. * Strong judgment under incomplete information, and the credibility to tell a customer "we don't support that reliably yet, here's what we do, and here's how we'd prove the next step." * Comfort talking to engineers, operators, RevOps, sales leaders, executives, and security teams in the same week. **Especially valuable:** Salesforce architecture and write\-back, telephony provisioning and routing, realtime voice AI, and freight/logistics/TMS experience. What this is not Not pure engineering. Not classic sales engineering that ends at signature. Not implementation consulting. You win the customer, deploy the customer, and improve the product because of what you learned doing both. If you're happiest with a hard problem instead of a detailed ticket, and your instinct after solving something is "how do we turn this into a capability we can use everywhere," this is the seat. Pay: $201,674\.00 \- $256,432\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Application Question(s): * Why do you want this job? * How do you tell the difference between a bug, a missing feature, and a customer who's using the product wrong? * What's a strong opinion you hold about building AI products that you think most engineers get wrong? * How are you using AI coding agents in your own work right now, and where have they burned you? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Associate iOS Developer
jobs.description: **Build mobile experiences that improve lives every day.** Join Resmed as an **Associate iOS Developer** and help create intuitive, high\-quality mobile experiences that support people’s health and well\-being. You'll be part of a new team focused on expanding the capabilities of the myAir application, contributing to innovative consumer\-facing solutions that bring new features and services to users. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced engineers, learn from technical leaders, and contribute to cloud\-native and mobile applications that are reliable, scalable, secure, and easy to use. If you're early in your career, passionate about mobile development, and excited by the opportunity to grow your skills while making a meaningful impact, we'd love to hear from you. **What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain native iOS applications using modern software engineering practices. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code with a focus on performance, scalability, reliability, and security. * Contribute to the design, development, testing, debugging, deployment, and support of mobile applications. * Collaborate with engineers, product teams, and stakeholders to understand user needs and deliver valuable solutions. * Support the integration of new capabilities and features into the MyAir application. * Participate in code reviews, testing activities, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Create and maintain technical documentation to support development and operational excellence. * Learn established development processes and contribute ideas that improve products and team outcomes. Work closely with a cross\-functional team in a collaborative, agile environment. * **What You Bring** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum of 2 years of related experience. * Knowledge of software development principles, practices, and methodologies. * Experience developing mobile applications or demonstrated experience through academic, personal, or professional projects. * Ability to analyse information, solve problems, and apply sound technical judgement. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. Eagerness to learn, grow, and contribute within a team environment. * **Nice to Have** * Experience with Swift and native iOS development. Mobile applications published to the App Store or portfolio projects available for review. * **What Sets You Apart** * **Curiosity** : You actively explore new ideas, technologies, and ways of solving problems. * **Growth Mindset** : You see challenges as opportunities to learn and continuously improve. * **Ownership** : You take responsibility for your work and follow through on commitments. * **Collaboration** : You build positive working relationships and enjoy learning from others. * **Initiative** : You go beyond minimum requirements and look for opportunities to create value. * **Resilience** : You adapt well to change and stay focused when working through complex challenges. **Why Join Resmed** At Resmed, your work has a direct impact on people's lives. We develop technology that helps millions of people around the world sleep better, breathe better, and live healthier lives. You'll join a collaborative team where learning is encouraged, innovation is valued, and your contributions matter. This is an opportunity to build your career alongside talented colleagues while helping shape the next generation of digital health experiences. We are shaping the future at ResMed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD\&D, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees receive Flexible Time Off (FTO), 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members. Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills. At ResMed, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this position is: $90,000 \- $113,000 USD. Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Computer Graphics
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 41696 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a deep background in 3D computer graphics and engine development to join the ML Data Pod within the Foundation AI team. In this role, you will build the foundational infrastructure that powers our next\-generation AI capabilities. As the AI landscape rapidly shifts toward spatial and 3D generation, high\-quality data has become the ultimate bottleneck. You will be instrumental in solving this challenge by unlocking the Roblox engine as a massive, scalable platform for synthetic data generation. This is a unique opportunity to bridge the gap between cutting\-edge AI research and low\-level engine architecture. You will be navigating unmapped territory—shaping how we represent and structure complex 3D data (such as meshes, materials, lighting, and scene graphs) to effectively train state\-of\-the\-art 3DGen models. Ultimately, the synthetic pipelines you architect will directly fuel the frontier AI models that will define the future of immersive 3D content creation for millions of creators worldwide. ### **Responsibilities** * **Synthetic Data Generation:** Spearhead initiatives to leverage the Roblox engine to procedurally generate the massive, high\-fidelity 3D datasets required for training frontier 3DGen models. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with AI research scientists to translate complex model training requirements into actionable engine features, while collaborating with core engine teams to implement them safely and efficiently. * **Pipeline Architecture:** Design, build, and optimize scalable graphics and engine\-level systems capable of generating diverse spatial, geometric, and visual data at scale. * **Technical Integration:** Drive the technical direction for embedding synthetic data generation workflows into the existing engine architecture without compromising core performance. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience building and shipping complex, production\-grade software systems * Deep expertise in 3D computer graphics, rendering pipelines, and game engine architecture. * Strong proficiency in systems programming (e.g., C\+\+) with a proven track record of writing highly optimized, scalable code. * Experience extracting, modifying, or manipulating programmatic data from within a complex engine environment. * Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to bridge the gap between machine learning researchers and low\-level systems engineers. * *Bonus:* Familiarity with machine learning data pipelines, automated synthetic data generation, or 3D generative AI architectures. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Background in geometry, linear algebra, or related mathematical domains * Experience with graphics APIs or frameworks a plus but not required For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full\-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**. Annual Salary Range $227,370—$295,250 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Roboflow Labs **Compensation** ---------------- * $250K – $450K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Total cash comp scales significantly with performance. **Who We Are** -------------- Roboflow is building the visual cortex for AGI. Every day, millions of developers and half of the Fortune 100 use Roboflow to count cells to accelerate cancer research, improve construction site safety, digitize floor plans, preserve coral reef populations, guide drone flight, and much more. We have built the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. We're supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $100 million from Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, Y Combinator, and more. **Roboflow Labs** is our applied research unit. We train our own open models (RF\-DETR). We build our own benchmarks grounded in real enterprise use cases (RF100\-VL). And we partner with frontier labs to deliver the training data they need to advance the capabilities that drive the most value back to our customers. Behind all of it is a global network of millions of Roboflow developers who have annotated billions of images and videos to date, as well as a proven enterprise business that is exploding as AI traverses the physical economy. **What You'll Do** ------------------ As a Senior Software Engineer at Roboflow Labs, you'll build the platform that turns a frontier lab's data request into a shipped, quality\-checked delivery. * Design, build, and own the Labs data platform end to end: client\-facing catalog and delivery portal, contributor\-facing collection and payout tooling, and the shared data foundation underneath. * Build delivery pipelines that ingest, validate, package, and ship datasets with the provenance, rights tracking, and audit trail that frontier lab procurement teams require * Automate quality: consensus, review routing, fraud and duplicate detection, and the metrics that make dataset quality visible before it reaches a customer * Partner with Strategic Projects Leads and operators to turn each new delivery into reusable infrastructure rather than a one\-off * Integrate with Roboflow's core platform and open\-source tooling so that Labs benefits from, and contributes back to, the product millions of developers already use * Set the engineering bar for a new team: architecture, code review, observability, and the on\-call and release practices that let a small group ship reliably. **Who You Are** --------------- You are a senior full stack engineer who likes building zero\-to\-one. You have high agency and a bias toward action. * 6\+ years building production software, with real depth in backend systems, data pipelines, or full\-stack engineering. * Experience designing systems that process large volumes of data reliably. * Strong product judgment. * Nice to have: experience with annotation or human\-data platforms, marketplaces with payouts, ML training data pipelines, or computer vision tooling **Where You'll Work** --------------------- Roboflow is a fully distributed company with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Singapore, and Brazil. Roboflow Labs works in person in San Francisco. We host full company retreats twice per year. **What You'll Receive** ----------------------- The target compensation for this role is **$250,000 – $450,000** base salary commensurate with experience as well as equity in the company. Total cash comp is expected to scale significantly with growth of Roboflow Labs. In addition, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights: * Generous stipends covering travel, productivity, tools, meals, and office. * Up to 100% of your health insurance costs covered. * Unlimited PTO \- with an annual 2 week minimum. * 12 weeks parental leave **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. **Learn More About Us** ----------------------- At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. Compensation Range: $250K \- $450K

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - AI/ML (Remote)
jobs.description: We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms. We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one's overall well\-being. We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence\-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare. Rula is a remote\-first company. We currently hire in most U.S. states, with the exception of Hawaii. **About the Role** We are seeking an Engineering Manager for AI/ML to enable Rula’s AI Engineering team through technical leadership across both applied product capabilities and foundational ML platforms. This person will be responsible for guiding a highly AI\-native group of Senior and Staff engineers to rapidly deliver user\-facing features such as transcript summarization and search relevance, while simultaneously architecting our core AI/ML infrastructure such as feature store and AI observability platform. This person will apply a balance of strong execution speed, Radical Candor in their coaching, and rigorous clinical safety sense to ensure our solutions and models scale safely. You will be at the vanguard of Rula's AI engineering, shaping a culture of high talent density and driving technological synergy that directly transforms how mental healthcare is delivered and experienced. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering and machine learning experience, including 5\+ years designing, scaling, and deploying distributed backend systems in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, etc.) * 3\+ years of direct engineering management experience, with a proven track record of hiring, retaining, and directly managing high\-performing Senior and Staff\-level engineers. * 3\+ years of experience technically leading or building core ML infrastructure, such as feature stores, MLOps pipelines, model deployment systems, or AI observability platforms. * 2\+ years of experience directing or developing production\-grade applied AI features, specifically focusing on LLM integrations (e.g., NLP, transcript summarization, RAG) or search, ranking, and relevance engines * Proven operational track record of concurrently managing the delivery of both user\-facing product features and backend infrastructure platform work across multiple production release cycles. **Preferred Qualifications** * Regulated Industry Experience: Experience shipping advanced AI systems in high\-stakes, regulated environments (such as HealthTech or FinTech), with a proven ability to balance rigorous privacy, compliance (e.g., HIPAA), and safety standards without grinding engineering velocity to a halt. * Advanced AI Evaluation Expertise: Deep, hands\-on experience designing rigorous, production\-ready evaluation frameworks for LLMs—combining automated metrics, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, and Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) processes specifically aimed at mitigating hallucinations and bias in mission\-critical applications. * AI\-Augmented Engineering Philosophy: A strongly defined, practiced philosophy on using AI to multiply engineering output. We are looking for someone who doesn't just build AI, but actively deploys cutting\-edge AI dev tools (e.g., coding agents, advanced IDE integrations, automated testing bots) to push an already high\-performing team to hyper\-efficiency. * Framework for Dual\-Mandate Prioritization: Nuanced experience and a clear, communicable framework for managing the specific tension between short\-term product delivery and long\-term platform investments, demonstrating exactly how they prioritize technical debt and infrastructure scaling against aggressive feature sprints. **We're serious about your well\-being! As part of our team, full\-time employees receive:** * **100% remote work environment:** Working hours to support a healthy work\-life balance, ensuring you can meet both professional and personal commitments (must be based in United States, currently not hiring in Hawaii) * **Attractive pay and benefits**: Full transparency of pay ranges regardless of where you live in the United States * **Comprehensive health benefits**: Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and FSA/HSA * **401(k) plan access**: Start saving for your future * **Generous time\-off policies**: Including 2 company\-wide shutdown weeks each year for self\-care (for most employees) * **Paid parental leave**: Available for all parents, including birthing, non\-birthing, adopting, and fostering * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)**: Supporting your mental and physical health * **Quarterly department stipend**: Fun team\-building activities or in\-person gatherings * **Community and employee resource groups**: Participate in groups that celebrate employee identity and lived experiences, fostering a sense of community and belonging for all * **Home office stipend:** New hire home office stipend \& $50 monthly stipend to help cover internet or cell phone expenses * **Wellness at Rula program:** Year\-round wellness initiatives and a $50/month wellness stipend **Our team** We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental to our mission of making mental healthcare work for everyone. We are dedicated to having a culture of inclusion that will support our employees in feeling safe, seen, heard, and valued. Compensation Range: $208K \- $260K

jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description: **Department:** Housing **Reports To:** Executive Director **Employment Status:** Full\-Time **Location:** SEPP Housing Properties and Administrative Offices Director of Operations – Affordable Housing, Property Management, Development \& Consulting The SEPP Group is seeking an experienced Director of Operations to provide leadership across its affordable housing portfolio while supporting the continued growth and expansion of the organization. This position will oversee housing operations, property management, compliance, resident services, while also playing a significant role in new housing development, organizational expansion, funding strategy, and the continued development of SEPP’s consulting services. The ideal candidate will bring hands\-on experience in affordable housing operations, federal, state, and local housing programs, staff supervision, regulatory compliance, grant administration, housing development, and community development. This position requires someone who can balance high\-level organizational planning with regular involvement in property and program operations. Responsibilities Housing Operations and Staff Leadership · Provide overall leadership and oversight of SEPP’s affordable housing properties and housing programs. · Directly supervise and support the Housing Operations and Compliance Coordinator and property management staff, establishing clear expectations for property oversight, file review, occupancy, resident concerns, inspections, maintenance issues, and operational consistency. · Work closely with the Housing Operations and Compliance Coordinator to ensure accurate and timely information regarding conditions at each property is provided to senior leadership. · Maintain regular communication with Housing Operations and Compliance Coordinator, property managers and staff and provide guidance on operational, compliance, resident, and lease\-related concerns. · Foster accountability while providing staff with mentorship, training, and professional development opportunities. · Identify operational concerns early and develop practical solutions to prevent larger organizational or compliance issues. · Develop and update policies and procedures that improve consistency, efficiency, documentation, and resident services throughout the organization. Compliance and Program Oversight · Maintain strong oversight of federal, state, and local affordable housing requirements applicable to SEPP properties and programs. · Provide leadership on regulatory compliance including but not limited to New York State HCR, HUD, Rural Development, tax credit programs, and other funding or regulatory agencies. · Ensure property files, tenant eligibility documentation, inspections, reporting, and operational practices are maintained in preparation for monitoring and regulatory review. · Work with staff to correct compliance deficiencies and strengthen internal systems as well as identify outside monitoring/training resources as appropriate and budgeted. · Coordinate with funding agencies, consultants, auditors, attorneys, and other professionals when necessary. Housing Development and Organizational Expansion · Work directly with the Executive Director and organizational leadership to identify opportunities for new affordable housing development, acquisition, rehabilitation, and preservation. · Assist with evaluating potential development sites and projects, including preliminary feasibility, funding opportunities, operational considerations, and long\-term sustainability. · Participate in pre\-development activities and coordinate with municipalities, developers, architects, engineers, attorneys, lenders, nonprofit partners, and public funding agencies. · Help develop financing strategies using available federal, state, local, and private resources, including affordable housing and community development funding. · Support grant applications, funding proposals, project budgets, development schedules, and other materials necessary to advance projects. · Evaluate opportunities to expand SEPP’s housing portfolio while ensuring that organizational staffing and operational systems grow alongside the portfolio. · Develop partnerships with municipalities, nonprofit organizations, housing agencies, developers, and community organizations that can support future development opportunities. · Assist leadership in identifying geographic areas and populations where SEPP’s experience can be used to address unmet housing needs. Financial and Organizational Management · Assist the Executive Director with operating budgets, program budgets, development budgets, financial planning, and long\-term organizational strategy. · Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining strong resident services. · Assist in evaluating staffing needs as properties, programs, development activities, and consulting services expand. · Work collaboratively with leadership to establish measurable organizational goals and track progress. · Provide the Executive Director with accurate, timely information necessary for operational and strategic decision\-making. Qualifications · Significant professional experience in affordable housing, housing administration, community development, nonprofit operations, property management, or a related field. · Demonstrated experience supervising staff and coordinating multiple programs or operational responsibilities. · Strong working knowledge of affordable housing programs and regulatory requirements at the federal, state, and local levels. · Experience with housing compliance, tenant eligibility, inspections, occupancy, resident services, and property operations. · Experience with grant\-funded housing or community development programs and the administration of public funding. · Experience participating in housing development, rehabilitation, acquisition, preservation, or other real estate development activities. · Ability to work effectively with municipalities, government agencies, nonprofit organizations, consultants, attorneys, contractors, developers, and funding partners. · Strong organizational, financial, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. · Ability to develop systems, policies, and procedures while remaining actively involved in day\-to\-day operations. · Experience with Yardi or comparable property management software preferred. · Experience developing consulting, fee\-for\-service, or external management services is preferred. Education and Professional Experience A bachelor’s or associate degree in business, real estate, finance, accounting, community development, social sciences, or a related field is preferred. Significant directly related professional experience in affordable housing, housing programs, community development, nonprofit management, or housing development may be considered in combination with education. Relevant affordable housing, occupancy, tax credit, property management, or compliance certifications are preferred but may be obtained following employment. jobs.description: SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology. **Job Description** **Site Reliability Engineer** **Locations** : Boston/Waltham, MA \| Hybrid **Get To Know us:** SS\&C is seeking out talented candidates for the position of Site Reliability Engineer. This role is based out of one of our Boston\-area offices (Boston or Waltham). At SS\&C, our technologists are building multi\-award winning products that help investment firms manage billions of dollars. Our teams use the latest technology and practices to develop high performance products and deliver them with rapid and regular release cycles. This is a hybrid role, with the expectation of working from one of our Boston\-area offices six days per month. **Why You Will Love It Here!** * **Flexibility** : Hybrid Work Model and Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans * **Your Future:** 401k Matching Program, Professional Development Reimbursement * **Work/Life Balance:** Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, Paid Holidays * **Your Wellbeing:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave * **Wide Ranging Perspectives:** Committed to Celebrating the Variety of Backgrounds, Talents and Experiences of Our Employees * **Training:** Hands\-On, Team\-Customized, including SS\&C University * **Extra Perks:** Discounts on fitness clubs, travel and more! **What You Will Get To Do:** * Automating infrastructure configuration using AWS CloudFormation, Chef, Packer, and Terraform * Automating tasks and ChatOps integration with Lambda functions (Python / Node.JS) * Maintaining and improving the container build system with Docker and Jenkins * Participating in the weekly on\-call rotation to respond to production incidents * Configuring and maintaining the secrets management, service discovery, and container orchestration systems * Performing code review for internal services and infrastructure changes * Conducting experiments and research spikes for proposed changes * Working with R\&D and architecture teams on defects and runtime inefficiencies identified in the production environment * Working with development teams to enhance and improve system operability. * Defining, tracking, and maintaining Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets in partnership with development teams * Building and maintaining observability pipelines and dashboards using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Splunk to ensure system health and performance visibility Leading incident response and managing on\-call escalations via PagerDuty; facilitating blameless post\-mortems to drive systemic improvements * **What You Will Bring:** * BS or MS in Computer Science or similar discipline * Strong work ethic and personal drive to learn and continuously improve yourself, and the systems you own * Ability to perform under pressure in a fast\-paced environment * 5\+ years of experience working in a Linux environment * 5\+ years of cloud computing administration and engineering (i.e. Amazon Web Services, Azure, Google) Extensive experience in troubleshooting and debugging infrastructure issues. * **Preferred Experience:** * Experience in development with modern programming languages (i.e. Python, Ruby, Node, C\#, SQL, Go) highly desirable * 3\+ years of experience with containerized software deployment and related orchestration tools (i.e. Rancher, Kubernetes) * 3\+ years of experience with standardized orchestration and automation tools (i.e. Chef, Puppet, Ansible, SaltStack, Terraform) * Active interest in new technology and emerging engineering practices Experience leveraging AI tools across the engineering workflow, including AI\-assisted coding (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor), AIOps and observability platforms (e.g., PagerDuty AIOps), and LLM/AI service integrations; a genuine curiosity for how emerging AI capabilities can improve reliability and operational efficiency. * Thank you for your interest in SS\&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website: www.ssctech.com/careers . \#LI\-MB3 \#CA\-MB Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS\&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. SS\&C Technologies offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity. Actual base salary will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, prior experience, education, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Massachusetts: The expected base salary for the position is between 90000 USD to 110000 USD. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
